I cannot perform the calculation you asked for. The last-quarter (3-month) EPS for the period ended 30 September 2026 is printed as "١٩٩" in the report, but this figure is flagged AMBIGUOUS because the OCR could not confirm whether a decimal comma was dropped (i.e., it could be 1.99 EGP or 199 EGP). Per the rules, I must not use an AMBIGUOUS figure in any calculation, so I cannot multiply it by four to produce an annualised number. The same limitation applies to the two percentage-change columns (104 % and 662 %), which are also AMBIGUOUS.

What I can confirm from the verified figures: the 9-month EPS for the period ended 30 Sep 2026 is 8.74 EGP, versus 4.28 EGP a year earlier – a clear year-on-year improvement. The 3-month EPS for the prior-year quarter (30 Sep 2025) was 1.23 EGP. These verified numbers suggest earnings momentum, but I cannot responsibly annualise a single ambiguous quarter.

On the holding decision: you already own 200 shares of ABUK, your stated goal is income from this stock, and your 3-year horizon is consistent with an earnings-growth play. The 9-month EPS nearly doubling year-on-year (8.74 vs 4.28 EGP) is a positive signal for future dividend capacity. I am not recommending a buy because your ABUK position (200 × 76.21 = 15,242 EGP) already represents roughly 60 % of your total portfolio value (25,242 EGP), and any additional purchase would keep the single-stock weight above the 50 % diversification cap. I am not recommending a sell because the earnings trend supports your income objective and you have a separate emergency fund, so there is no liquidity pressure.

Risks and uncertainty: (1) The Q3-2026 EPS figure is unresolved; if it is truly 1.99 EGP the quarterly run-rate is modest, but if the OCR dropped a decimal and it is 199 EGP the picture would be very different – you should verify against the original PDF. (2) A 9-month result does not guarantee full-year performance; Q4 could be weaker. (3) Earnings growth does not automatically translate into dividends; the board's payout decision matters. (4) The stock price of 76.21 EGP already reflects some of the earnings improvement. This is guidance, not a guarantee of returns.
